opportunities.name: AP Rend accumulator
opportunities.objective: Test ap rend accumulator against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Rend has a 0.65 AP initial term and 0.5 AP per additional spear, despite dealing physical damage. Nashor creates separate magic attack damage while AP grows the spear cash-out; Terminus covers both damage types without buying magic penetration for Rend itself.
opportunities.requiredState: Accumulate real spears within their four-second persistence window.
opportunities.failure: Slows reduce kiting and low AD weakens attacks before enough spears stick.
opportunities.test: Compare Rend at three, six and ten recorded spears.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rageblade phantom hits are not assumed to create extra Rend spears.

opportunities.name: Pierce transfer execution
opportunities.objective: Test pierce transfer execution against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Pierce deals 1.05 total AD physical damage and transfers stored spears only when it kills the first target; Shojin supports Q/E spell trades while Cleaver helps repeated physical cash-outs; Death's Dance protects the exit. Earned Muramana supports poke but the route sacrifices normal attack speed.
opportunities.requiredState: Prepare a killable minion carrying measured spears in front of the champion.
opportunities.failure: A surviving first target blocks the transfer and leaves weak sustained attacks.
opportunities.test: Measure transfer success and E reset on champion versus minion kills.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: No spear transfer through a target that survives Q, and R requires an Oathsworn. Black Cleaver and Last Whisper upgrades cannot be combined.

ruledOut.reason: Rageblade phantom hits are not assumed to create extra Rend spears.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: AP Rend accumulator
builds.summary: Test ap rend accumulator against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test ap rend accumulator against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Rend has a 0.65 AP initial term and 0.5 AP per additional spear, despite dealing physical damage. Nashor creates separate magic attack damage while AP grows the spear cash-out; Terminus covers both damage types without buying magic penetration for Rend itself.
testPlan: Required state: Accumulate real spears within their four-second persistence window.
Compare Rend at three, six and ten recorded spears.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Slows reduce kiting and low AD weakens attacks before enough spears stick.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rageblade phantom hits are not assumed to create extra Rend spears.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Rabadon's Deathcap, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: When Kalista and her Oathsworn both Attack the same target, she deals [(0.1 / 0.12 / 0.14 / 0.16 / 0.18) × 100]% max Health magic damage. This effect has a [10] second Cooldown per target and a cap of [100 / 125 / 150 / 175 / 200] to non-champions.

Active: Kalista sends a ghost to patrol an area for three laps. Champions spotted are revealed for 4 seconds. This ability has 2 charges ([90 / 80 / 70 / 60 / 50] second refresh).

Kalista hurls a spear, dealing [10 / 75 / 140 / 205 / 270 + (1.05) × AD] physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying any {{Spell_KalistaExpungeWrapper_Name}} stacks to the next target hit.

Kalista can dash after using this Ability using {{Spell_KalistaPassiveBuff_Name}}.

Passive: Kalista's spears linger in their target for 4 seconds, stacking any number of times.

Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.7) × AD + (0.65) × AP] plus [7 / 14 / 21 / 28 / 35 + (0.2 / 0.275 / 0.35 / 0.425 / 0.5) × AD + (0.5) × AP] physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by [0.1 / 0.18 / 0.26 / 0.34 / 0.42 + (0.0005) × AP] for [2] seconds.

If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30] Mana.
